summary: Wix.com Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing an organizational realignment, including scaling down or discontinuing certain activities/products and reducing its workforce by ~20% (1,000 employees). The company expects to incur ~$30-35 million in pre-tax restructuring charges, mostly cash severance, with majority in Q2 2026 and cash paid in H2 2026. FY 2026 free cash flow excluding costs is guided to ~$420 million, a $20 million increase, with bookings reduced by ~$50 million and revenue by ~$25 million, offset by ~$70 million in non-GAAP cost savings. Watch for execution on headcount reduction and revenue impact.
